#dusk $DUSK @Dusk_Foundation  In the past few days, the order book for $DUSK  has been moving very strongly. I also generally have high expectations for this asset’s long-term potential. However, trading is especially afraid of blind optimism, so I specifically looked into Dusk’s underlying rules and ran a sandbox simulation under the assumption of an extreme one-sided crash.

The result exposed a hidden pit: when the crash hits, even if you wildly increase miner fees (Gas) to cut your losses, there’s a high chance your transaction simply won’t be able to be sent. The culprit behind this is not actually on-chain.

Once you confirm something in your wallet, the instruction must first be relayed to the RPC server—this is basically the blockchain’s “data transfer station.” After the Boreas iteration, Dusk granted these relays the ability to independently throttle requests. If your interface shows a 403 message, it means the other side outright refused to sign your request. If you get 429, that indicates network congestion, and you’ll need to come back later. The core issue is that with either of these errors, your instruction never even enters the memory pool waiting to be packaged. If you never even got a queue number, then boosting Gas to the moon is futile.

This firewall’s original intent is good—it can prevent script bombing. But in a real fight with real stakes, it becomes the small retail traders’ weak spot. People used to compete on-chain with their financial power (Gas bidding). Now it’s a competition over “infrastructure resources.” Big players set up their own nodes and buy VIP relay channels, so they can enter anytime. Meanwhile, most of us default to connecting to free endpoints—when the market gets a sudden needle, we get pushed off the line instantly.

Once you understand this, the self-protection strategy must change:
- If you encounter a 403 error: don’t touch Gas—immediately switch to another RPC link.
- If you hit a 429: pause briefly, then quickly switch to a backup channel.

Timing for adding fees: Only when the node has already accepted the transaction but it keeps getting stuck in a Pending state will increasing Gas be effective.

Digging deeper, this directly affects my valuation logic for DUSK. On-chain fees are cheap, which very likely means the real buy/sell demand is being blocked before it even reaches the relays/data transfer stations. If smooth channels are monopolized by a small number of people, then a large portion of the ecosystem’s potential upside is siphoned away by those “bucket-shoveling” off-chain institutions.

To support a high market cap, simply showing @Dusk_Foundation  TPS is absolutely not enough. The official team must publish hard metrics end-to-end, such as how often 403/429 triggers occur, and the number of separate free RPC endpoints, etc. If the door isn’t opened for retail users, then “ecosystem” is just empty talk. This hidden flaw is something I will keep tracking. #eth $ETH

#dusk $DUSK @Dusk_Foundation  这几天 $DUSK 的盘面走得很强势，我平时也比较看好这个标的的长期空间。不过做交易最怕盲目乐观，所以我特意拿 Dusk 的底层规则，在极端单边暴跌的假设下做了个沙盘推演。结果摸出了一个暗坑：当暴跌来临时，哪怕你疯狂拉高矿工费（Gas）想割肉，单子也极有可能发不出去。这背后的元凶，根本不在链上。

咱们钱包点确认后，指令得先传给 RPC 服务端，这就相当于公链的“数据接发站”。自从 Boreas 迭代之后，Dusk 赋予了这些接发站自主限流的权限。如果你的界面跳出 403 提示，意思是对方直接拒签你的请求；要是报 429，那就是线路拥堵，让你晚点再来。核心问题在于：碰到这两种报错，你的指令根本还没进入待打包的内存池。既然连排队的号都没拿上，给再高的 Gas 也是徒劳。

这套防火墙初衷不错，能防住脚本轰炸。但在真刀真枪的博弈里，这就成了散户的软肋。原先大家在链上拼财力（Gas竞价），现在变成了拼“基建资源”。大户自己搭节点、买VIP通道，随时能进场；而咱们默认连着免费接口，行情一插针，瞬间就被挤掉线。

弄懂了这个，防身策略必须改：遇 403 报错： 别去提 Gas，立刻换个 RPC 链接。撞上 429： 稍微停顿，赶紧切备用通道。

加钱时机： 只有节点已经受理，但单子一直卡在 Pending 状态时，拉高 Gas 才能起效。

往深了想，这直接影响我对DUSK的估值逻辑。链上手续费便宜，很可能是真实的买卖需求全被挡在了接发站外头。如果顺畅的通道被少数人垄断，那生态里很大一部分红利，就被这些“卖铲子”的链外机构抽走了。

要支撑高市值，@Dusk_Foundation 仅仅秀 TPS 绝对不够。官方必须把 403/429 触发频次、独立的免费 RPC 数量等硬指标全盘托出。大门不给散户开，生态就是一句空话。这个硬伤，我会持续追踪。#eth $ETH

I’ve seen too many setups like this. Fear stopped you from buying yesterday, and greed made you chase higher today. What the market is best at is getting you to make the “emotionally correct” decision at the wrong time.

There’s only one rule of discipline: don’t chase with positions that weren’t established before the breakout.

━━━ Strategy Direction ━━━
Holders: $75,000 is the key support. If it holds, continue holding; if it breaks, reduce exposure and wait.

SEC and CFTC classify XRP and SOL as commodities: this time, it’s not a negative—it’s regulatory easing

The two major U.S. regulators have moved XRP and SOL into the commodities category, bypassing SEC securities regulation—an upside catalyst directly.

Against the backdrop of the crypto policy shift, the SEC and CFTC have classified XRP and SOL as commodities. Don’t underestimate this classification—securities and commodities follow completely different regulatory paths in the U.S. Securities have to go through the SEC’s issuance and disclosure framework; commodities fall under the CFTC, where constraints are much looser. XRP has been tangled in an SEC lawsuit for four years because of the question of whether it counts as a security. Now that the classification is finalized, it effectively stamps these coins with a legal identity, and future legislation and regulatory frameworks will be adjusted around this categorization.

The market is already reacting: XRP is up 16.23% in 24 hours to $1.419, the strongest among major coins; SOL is up 5.23% to $91.1. BTC $91.1,316.01 (+7.88%), and ETH $2,388.05 (+4.95%) are also strengthening.

Market impact
- Short term: Regulatory certainty is one of the hardest catalysts, especially for XRP, which has been under litigation pressure for years. This is basically “bad news fully priced in” plus an identity turn to approved—capital is clearly flowing back. Risk appetite across the broader market is also boosted; BTC holding above $91.1K suggests this isn’t just altcoin hype.
- Medium term: Classifying them as commodities means subsequent legislation will likely revolve around the CFTC framework. More tokens may be handled along this path. Listing standards on exchanges and institutional compliance channels are likely to loosen, and the industry landscape should move in a more positive direction.

My take
Strongly bullish. Regulatory classification is a trend-level positive, not a one-day trade. After BTC stabilizes at $91.1,316.01, the area around $91.1K is near-term support—only if it breaks would I turn more cautious. After XRP jumps 16%, don’t chase in the short term; a pullback to confirm would make the trend healthier. The key risk is policy reversal—if the classification document faces legal challenges, sentiment could drop quickly, so this needs close monitoring.

SEC和CFTC在加密政策转向的背景下，把XRP和SOL定性为大宗商品。别小看这个定性，证券和大宗商品在美国的监管路径完全不同：证券要走SEC的发行、披露那一套，大宗商品归CFTC管，约束宽松得多。XRP之前被SEC诉讼缠了四年，就是卡在“是不是证券”这个问题上。现在定性落地，等于给这些币的法律身份盖了章，未来立法和监管框架都会围绕这个分类重新调整。

盘面已经在给反应了：XRP 24小时涨16.23%报$1.419，是主流币里最猛的；SOL涨5.23%报$91.1。BTC $91.1,316.01（+7.88%）、ETH $2,388.05（+4.95%）跟着走强。

- 中期：定性为商品意味着后续立法会围绕CFTC框架展开，更多代币可能参照这个路径处理。交易所上币门槛、机构合规通道都会跟着松，行业格局往好的方向走。

Now that both major regulators have softened their stance, it effectively grants these two blockchain networks a “non-security” passport.

In other words, it has the entire chain—from issuance and custody to quotation on regulated trading—put together end to end.

But no matter how good the card looks, if you dig deeper, it still makes you uneasy—because this setup relies extremely heavily on a “single core node.”

To put it plainly, DuskTrade can move more than €300 million in securities onto the chain, and its confidence all comes from NPEX’s qualifications and its committed funds. In other words, NPEX is the absolute centerpiece of the whole big plan. Imagine what happens if, one day, NPEX’s internal operations run into trouble—or if it can’t withstand local regulatory pressure and announces it’s no longer playing. Dusk doesn’t have a second licensed institution of the same caliber it can conjure up on the fly to rescue the situation. This kind of deep, exclusive binding is exactly the Achilles’ heel that could choke it at any moment.

What’s even more frustrating is that the pace of business rollout isn’t fully controlled by the public chain itself. Even HTX admits that “timing risk” objectively exists. Although the EU has MiFID II, MiCA, and DLT pilots to backstop the market, the global financial industry’s attitude toward tokenization is still completely split between ice and fire. In its November 2025 report, IOSCO clearly sounded the alarm and pointed directly to new regulatory risks embedded in this space. Domestically, the CSRC has recently taken decisive action via window guidance, effectively blocking the RWA path that securities firms were pursuing in Hong Kong.

This brings us to a painful reality: no matter how brilliant the underlying code is, it’s useless without real funds and assets to run on. Dusk’s current situation is that the technical logic works, but the business closed loop is extremely dependent on the traditional finance establishment’s facial expressions. As soon as macro policy tightens, or a key ally drops out, the entire infrastructure could grind to a halt. In this line of work, lacking a “Plan B” for self-defense really isn’t acceptable—and this is exactly where I’m truly worried about the trajectory after $DUSK . #eth $ETH

title: Неочікуваний зліт $BTC
subTitle:
Змова чи спланована кампанія сім’ї Трампа, щоб заробити ще більше на криптовалюті?
19 серпня 2026 року на крипторинку стався масовий шорт-сквіз. Саме по $BTC за одну годину було примусово ліквідовано понад $1 млрд коротких позицій, а за 24 години обсяг ліквідованих BTC-шортів сягнув близько $1,7 млрд. Загалом по крипторинку за добу було знищено близько $3 млрд ведмежих ставок.
Це стало можливим тому, що останні місяці ринок був ведмежим і трейдери масово стояли в шортах. Достатньо було сильного руху BTC вгору і почався ланцюг примусових ліквідацій, які, у свою чергу, ще сильніше підштовхнули ціну.
Чому так сталося?
Спочатку Мінфін США збільшив обсяг викупу довгострокових облігацій. Ринок сприйняв це як сигнал можливого збільшення ліквідності.
А потім Трамп зібрав у Білому домі керівників Coinbase, Kraken, Robinhood та інших криптокомпаній разом із представниками SEC і CFTC та закликав Конгрес схвалити Clarity Act — закон, який має створити чіткі правила для крипторинку США.
І ринок вибухнув 💥
BTC піднявся майже до $70 000, $ETH показав ще сильніший рух, а крипторинок загалом пішов угору.
Чого очікувати далі?
15 вересня 2026 року Сенат має повернутися до розгляду Clarity Act. Це може стати одним із ключових моментів для крипторинку США.
А для сім’ї Трампа крипторинок — це вже великий бізнес. За даними Reuters, криптопроєкти принесли родині понад $1,4 млрд. Trump Media також накопичує біткоїни, а World Liberty Financial активно розвиває власну криптофінансову екосистему.
Тому питання виникає саме по собі: чи може політична підтримка крипторинку одночасно бути вигідною сім’ї Трампа?
Це ще не доказ змови. Але збіг інтересів дуже цікавий.
Що далі?
Ходять чутки, що продавці закінчилися і розворот уже відбувся.
Інші дивляться на чотирирічний цикл $BTC . Якщо історія повториться, справжнє дно може бути ще попереду — орієнтовно в районі жовтня.
Хто правий — не знає ніхто.
Можливо, ми вже побачили кінець ведмежого ринку.
А можливо, це просто дуже красивий short squeeze перед наступним падінням.
Тож рекомендую пристебнутися. Наступні пів року точно не будуть нудними. 🚀#BTC #ETH

With BTC’s rebound, Strategy’s Bitcoin holdings are now showing a floating profit of $1.4 billion, and the corporate coin-hoarding narrative is back in favor.

Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy)’s Bitcoin holdings have turned into a substantial floating gain following this round of BTC’s rebound, with book profit of about $1.4 billion. The company is the world’s largest corporate Bitcoin holder. Its core strategy is to use debt financing to buy BTC. When BTC fell from its previous highs, the book value was under pressure for a time, and the market even questioned whether this model would be sustainable. Now BTC is back at $77,053.99, up 6.37% over the past 24 hours. The holdings have returned to a comfortable zone—essentially a stress test validating the path of “allocating BTC to the corporate treasury.”

Impact on the market
- Short term: Positive for sentiment. Floating from loss to profit is the most straightforward narrative catalyst, strengthening institutions’ confidence in BTC as a reserve asset, and capital may continue to flow in. XRP is up more than 10% in 24 hours, indicating that overall risk appetite is recovering and it’s not a BTC-only show.
- Medium term: Strategy’s floating profit will become a template case. When other listed company CFOs read their financial statements, “swap part of the treasury cash for BTC” becomes a more convincing option. Corporate allocation demand is a slow variable, but the direction is accumulating.

My take
Bullish, but don’t chase. After BTC moves above $77,053.99, in the short term watch whether the 75K area can hold. If it holds, that provides the foundation for the rebound to continue. In a bear-market recovery, the most dangerous thing isn’t the drop—it’s that you can’t help yourself.

BTC $77,076 (+6.52%), ETH $2,418 (+4.52%). Prices are going up, but don’t forget—this is called a BEAR_RECOVERY, not a bull market. ETH’s structure looks worse: CHOP_MID means the direction hasn’t been established, and going long or short both drain your capital and patience.

The rebound comes, and the people who can’t hold cut losses and leave; then after another push higher, the ones who missed the move start chasing; and then the market hits you with a big red candle, and the people who just entered end up being the ones to take the other side. This isn’t a story—it’s the real loop most people go through.

━━━ How to look at things right now ━━━
BTC is repairing from the bottom of the bear market, with a slightly bullish bias, but the structure is still not clean. ETH hasn’t formed a trend—it's just grinding in a range. In this kind of market, keep your position size light and your patience heavy; your win rate is worth more than your diligence.

The right trade today happens at the moment you’re waiting, not at the moment you chase in.

Cboe has filed 3x leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs with the SEC, and they’ve entered the SEC public comment phase—another step forward for leveraged, compliance-style products.

Cboe previously submitted ETF applications for a 3x long BTC and a 3x long ETH. Now that the SEC has officially opened the comment period, it invites market participants to submit feedback within the specified timeframe. This is a standard process, but the timing matters: just two years ago, the SEC wouldn’t even approve a regular spot ETF. Yet leveraged derivative-structured products have progressed all the way to the comment stage. This suggests regulators’ default stance has shifted from “blocking” to “loosening.”

This time, it’s 3x leveraged products, where volatility is amplified threefold—one of the most aggressive tiers in the compliant toolset.

One-sentence translation: the SEC isn’t debating whether to open the “ETF door” to crypto anymore; it’s discussing how wide the door should open.

Market impact
- Short term: sentiment tailwind. BTC is currently at $77,327.11 (24h +6.50%), and ETH is at $2,425.04 (+4.17%). Since both are already in a rebound channel, the regulatory easing signal combined with expectations of ETF inflows directly supports BTC spot prices. The opening of the comment period itself doesn’t bring capital, but it confirms that the process is moving forward.
- Medium term: once leveraged ETFs are approved, they effectively provide traditional capital with a compliant amplified-return instrument, which should increase institutional allocation interest. At the same time, it squeezes the survival space for “shady” leveraged platforms, further consolidating the industry around licensed institutions.

Bullish overall. The reason is a clear transmission path: approval expectations for leveraged ETFs → more compliant capital enters → stronger BTC support. For ETH, the ability to hold near $2,400 is also worth watching—ETF narratives typically bring greater upside elasticity for ETH.

US Treasury Debt Breaks $4 Trillion: This BTC Rally Pushes to 77K as the Logic Quietly Shifts

The US debt has surpassed $4 trillion, which is a long-term positive for the BTC narrative. But in the short term, price still depends on liquidity and the mood of the US dollar.

The total US Treasury debt has officially crossed the $4 trillion mark, a historic milestone. The pace of debt expansion is still accelerating, and interest payments are taking up an increasing share of the budget. Analysts are very direct: every time this number climbs another rung, BTC’s long-term rationale as a “decentralized hard asset” gets that much stronger. At the same time, they also caution that the real driver of BTC’s short-term price is still US Treasury yields, the US Dollar Index, and global liquidity—while the debt story is a slow variable. Currently, BTC is trading at $77,398.01, up 6.20% over the past 24 hours. ETH is $2,423.83, up 3.30%.

Market impact
- Short term: Don’t expect debt-news headlines to directly lift the market. In the short run, price is anchored to the Federal Reserve’s path and the strength of the dollar. The debt data itself doesn’t create buy-side demand. Today’s 6% rally is more a market sentiment repair than an escalation of the debt narrative.
- Medium term: This is one of BTC’s most solid long-term stories. The stronger the expectation that fiscal deficits will be monetized, the greater the institutional incentive to allocate to BTC as a hedge. This is also where the underlying logic of ETF capital flows comes from.

My take
I’m bullish, but I see it in two time horizons. In the short term, BTC is around $77,398.01. Resistance is first seen at the 80K round-number level; support is around 73K. If BTC can hold above 80K, it will open up new upside space. The real significance of debt breaking $4 trillion is that it adds another narrative foundation for long-term holders—the dilution of fiat is certain, and BTC’s scarcity is also certain. The risk is: if Treasury yields spike due to concerns about debt, liquidity tightens, and in the short term that may suppress the coin price. Bullish narrative and liquidity headwinds could exist at the same time.

Strategy账面浮盈14亿美元：BTC反弹回成本线，机构示范效应来了

💡 Positive catalysts: BTC’s rebound is back above Strategy’s cost basis, and the company-level logic of accumulating coins is running again.

Strategy’s Bitcoin holdings have returned above the cost basis line, with an unrealized gain of $1.4 billion; the “institutional coin accumulation” narrative is revived.

What happened
This rebound pushed BTC to $77,398.01, up 6.20% in 24 hours. The price has once again climbed above Strategy’s overall cost basis line for its total BTC holdings (the original MicroStrategy). The company’s on-paper unrealized profit has returned to $1.4 billion. In plain terms: the “U.S. publicly traded company’s largest Bitcoin long,” which has been sitting at an unrealized loss on the books for the past few months, finally shows unrealized gains again.

One-sentence translation: The books of institutions using BTC as a reserve asset have been recalculated—and it works out again.

Market impact
- Short term: A direct positive boost in sentiment. Strategy’s unrealized profit implies that potential refinancing/buy-coin channels may reopen. In the past, whenever Strategy’s share price rose in tandem with BTC, the company would issue debt and/or equity to add to its position, creating a “rally → financing → buying → further rally” loop. BTC in the near term may challenge the $78K–$80K range; a pullback to $75K is the first support.
- Medium term: A demonstration effect for other listed companies. During earnings season, the idea that “holding BTC = unrealized gains on the books” will encourage more firms to allocate idle cash to BTC. With institutions adopting the same rhythm, the pace accelerates—one of the hardest narratives in this cycle.

My view
Clearly bullish. The $1.4 billion unrealized profit isn’t the key point—the key is the cost basis line being recovered after being lost. That sets an example for all corporate finance officers who have been watching from the sidelines. The risk is also very clear: if BTC falls back below $75K, the unrealized profit turns into an unrealized loss, and the narrative flips again. On positioning, just watch those two levels: $75K support and $80K resistance.

title: Ethereum ETF Pulls $221M as ETH Eyes Another Breakout
subTitle:
#ETH $ETH 
{spot}(ETHUSDT)
$ETH Ethereum is back in the spotlight after U.S. spot Ethereum ETF pulled more than $220 million in fresh capital on August 20. The funds recorded more $219 million in net inflows, extending their winning streak to four consecutive trading days. BlackRock’s ETHA once again dominated the session with about $173 million in inflows.
That puts the August 20 flow above the $189.15 million recorded one day earlier. The back to back inflows suggest institutional demand has not slowed after Ethereum’s sharp recovery.
ETH is also surging above the $2,300 level.  Ethereum trading around the $2,360 area in recent market data, with its market cap remaining above $270 billion.
BlackRock’s ETHA accounted for roughly $173 million of the August 20 inflows. That was followed by BlackRock’s ETHB with about $35.9 million, while Fidelity’s FETH added $5.8 million.
Bitwise’s ETHW brought in around $2.8 million. VanEck’s ETHV added another $1.7 million. The remaining products recorded either smaller flows or no meaningful change during the session.
The result is important because it came immediately after the $189 million inflow recorded on August 19. That earlier session had already been described as Ethereum’s strongest single day since October 2025.
As of now, August is shaping up as a major turnaround for Ethereum ETF. The funds had struggled through May and June, when combined net outflows exceeded $1 billion.
The money is moving in the opposite direction. Ethereum ETFs have posted several consecutive positive sessions while ETH has reclaimed levels that looked out of reach during the recent weakness.
Ethereum price action is giving the ETF numbers even more weight as it jumped sharply during the recent move, reaching above $2,300 and briefly trading near $2,400.
The token’s recovery also came with a sharp improvement in sentiment. Ethereum is now testing whether the $2,300 area can turn into support rather than another temporary stop. That matters because ETF demand is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore. Four straight days of inflows means institutions are adding exposure while ETH is already trading significantly above its recent lows.
There is another supply signal worth watching. Santiment data previously showed exchange held ETH falling from roughly 7.70 million coins on June 2 to 6.54 million on August 18. That represents a decline of around 15% over 11 weeks.
$ETH sitting on exchanges can reduce immediately available selling supply. Combined with stronger ETF demand, that creates an interesting setup if buying pressure continues.
The big question now is whether Ethereum can turn this ETF momentum into a sustained breakout as the $2,400 area is the next obvious test. If ETH clears it decisively while ETF inflows remain strong, the market could start looking toward the next major resistance levels.
For now, the message from Wall Street is getting louder: institutions are buying the dip, and Ethereum is listening.

I need to use this money next week. Even with the highest APY, I wouldn’t just save it carelessly.
Today I looked at TermMax’s lending market, and I almost made the same old mistake again: I immediately went to the column with the highest APY.
Then I thought better of it. Suppose I have 5,000 USDT, with 3,000 being idle funds, and the other 2,000 might need to be used as additional margin next week—these two sums basically can’t go into the same basket. For that latter 2,000, even if the page’s returns look great, I wouldn’t put it into a position that matures after the date I need the money.
#ETH  
TermMax’s fixed-rate lending isn’t hard to reason about: once you deposit the debt asset, you receive FT; then at maturity, you redeem it according to the rules. The yield and dates are easier to calculate at entry. But “easy to calculate” doesn’t mean “easy to get back anytime.” If you want to exit before maturity, you usually have to see whether there are buyers for FT at the time, and what the price looks like. When the market is thin, selling early at a discount may eat up the interest.
So now I don’t just ask, “What’s the annualized rate?” I first ask three questions:
When is the earliest I need to use the money?
Which day does the market position mature?
If I exit on short notice, is the depth of FT sufficient?
Here’s a very rough example. Put 5,000 USDT into a 30-day deal with an annualized return of 10%. If everything goes perfectly, you’d only make around forty-something U. If you need the money temporarily and have to endure an extra 1% discount to exit, then 50U would be gone. It looks like good returns, but once you do the math, you actually end up losing.
Of course, both the 10% and the 1% are just convenient assumptions to illustrate the point, not the current quotes.
This is also the biggest change in my view of TermMax recently. In the past, I thought the focus of fixed-rate lending was “the interest stays the same.” Now I feel it’s forcing you to confront the maturity: when the money comes back matters far more than whether the page shows a couple percent more or less.
If I really plan to use it, I’ll split the funds according to the dates I’ll need them. Keep a short-term reserve in hand, and for the portion that you know you won’t need for a while, match it with an appropriate maturity date. Don’t force yourself into a situation where you *have* to sell FT at a discount just to chase a few dozen U in expected gains.#termmax  @termmax

content:
这笔钱下周要用，再高的 APY 我也不敢随便存
今天看 TermMax 的出借市场，我差点又犯老毛病：先找 APY 最高的那一栏。
后来想想不对。假如手里有 5,000 USDT，其中 3,000 是闲钱，另外 2,000 下周可能要补保证金，那这两笔钱根本不能放在同一个篮子里。后面那 2,000，就算页面收益再好看，我也不会拿去做一个到期日晚于用钱日期的仓位。#ETH  
TermMax 的固定利率出借，逻辑不难：存入债务资产后拿到 FT，等到期按规则赎回。收益和日期在进场时更容易算清楚。可“算得清楚”不等于“随时都能拿回来”。没到期就想退出，通常要看 FT 当时有没有买家、价格怎么样，市场薄的时候，提前卖出的折价可能把利息吃掉。
所以我现在不会只问“年化多少”，而是先问三句：这笔钱最早什么时候要用？市场哪天到期？如果临时退出，FT 的深度够不够？
举个很粗的例子。5,000 USDT 做30天，年化按10%算，满打满算也就四十来U。要是为了临时用钱，退出时多承受1%的折价，50U就没了。看起来不错的收益，账一算反而倒贴。当然，10%和1%都只是方便说明的假设，不是当前报价。
这也是我最近看 TermMax 最大的改观。以前觉得固定利率的重点是“利息不变”，现在更觉得它是在逼人正视期限：钱什么时候回来，比页面上多两个点、少两个点重要得多。
真要用的话，我会把资金按用钱日期拆开。短期备用金留在手里，确定一段时间不用的部分，再去匹配合适的到期日。别为了几十U的预期收益，把自己逼成必须低价卖FT的人。#termmax  @termmax

After fully closing the position, I opened the trading app again.

$BTC  is now at 77,509, up 6.43% in the last 24 hours, with $3.239 billion USDT in volume.

Looking at this bullish candle right now—it’s so clean.

But yesterday afternoon, when I was staring at the exact same chart, my mind was full of hesitation.

Back then, there were no candlesticks on the right side—just a bunch of noise.

Hindsight like that is the most misleading.

It makes you feel the market should have been clear to read.

It makes you feel you’ll definitely be able to step in early next time.

But every stop-loss is a decision you made in the moment.

Your past self only had the information available at that time.

Don’t take the chart that has already played out and go blame the version of yourself that couldn’t see it.

And don’t trust hindsight to believe you can get it right next time.

Once the candlesticks are finished, that’s the path—before they finish, it’s all fog.

This move up to 77,509 served as a timely reminder for me.

The “in the moment” conviction, the momentum—it was something I endured back then, not something drawn afterward.

The chart is something that unfolds—not something you “figure out.”

8.22, $BTC , early morning analysis
We’re not going to look at moving averages or MACD. Let’s take a different “anti-human nature + deconstruct-the-play” angle to look at this dataset.
First, look at that sell order worth $75.94 million.
To retail traders, it looks like “a wall of selling pressure.” To the big players, it’s “bait.” If a real whale wanted to quietly unload, they would split the order into smaller lots and post them across different price levels. They would never hang an “obvious declaration” of nearly a hundred million in the order book to scare you. This order is placed at 79,555—only $445 away from the 80,000 round-number level. The purpose is overwhelmingly likely to be a “door sign” used to create panic—intentionally placing it there to push retail traders to cut long positions or even open shorts ahead of the 80,000 mark. Then they can take these short tickets in one bite and, in the momentum, drive the price up and break through 80,000. Next, look at the $1.111 billion net inflow.
But don’t get too excited yet. Think: who is buying? If it were all institutions accumulating aggressively, the price wouldn’t hover around 77,280 for so long—it would have been driven up in a straight line much earlier. Of that $1.111 billion, perhaps 70% is fueled by retail traders who chased in after seeing the big move—FOMO (fear of missing out). The main force is using retail traders’ money to prop up that “trap” at 79,555.
#BTC #ETH #BTC走势分析

Iran’s president has publicly urged an end to the war with the United States and Israel, claiming Tehran has the upper hand and signaling a cooling of the geopolitical conflict.

In his latest remarks, Iran’s president called for an end to conflicts with the U.S. and Israel, and his tone was very forceful—saying Tehran is the “side that has won.” In plain terms: he wants a ceasefire, but wants face. After all this fighting, oil prices are under pressure and regional stability is threatened. In reality, all parties have reasons to step down and take a path that lets them save face. - Short term: geopolitical tensions ease → oil prices fall → inflation expectations cool → rate-cut expectations rise → risk assets benefit. 对市场的影响
- 短期：地缘紧张缓和 → 油价回落 → 通胀预期降温 → 降息预期升温 → 风险资产受益。传导路径很清楚：避险资金从黄金、石油撤出，一部分会回流加密。BTC 24h 已经涨了 6.80% 到 $77,330.59，XRP 涨 9.66%，ETH 涨 3.21% 到 $2,401.84，市场已经用脚投票了。

我的判断
短期看多。停战信号 + 全市场普涨，情绪面和资金面共振。BTC 站稳 $77,330.59 之上，下一目标看 $80,000 整数关口；回踩 $75,000 不破就是强支撑。ETH 在 $2,400 附近，弹性略弱于大盘。风险点：伊朗国内强硬派反弹、谈判破裂，避险情绪重来会直接砸盘。仓位思路留一半清醒，地缘行情来得快去得也快。

Iran Calls for Ceasefire and Says It “Won” — Why Didn’t BTC Drop This Time, and Instead Rose?

💡 Impact on the Call: Bullish 📈 — Expectations of easing geopolitical tensions + a cooling in risk-off sentiment, raising the risk-asset inflow risk.

One sentence to make it clear: When the Iranian president publicly calls to end the war, the geopolitical risk premium starts to unwind, and BTC held up against sell pressure at $77,330.59.

What happened

The Iranian president directly said this fight with the United States and Israel should end, and he also claimed Tehran is the winner. In plain terms, it’s finding a way to save face—speech can’t lose, but the body wants a ceasefire. For the market, this signal matters far more than the back-and-forth rhetoric itself: the chain of “conflict escalation → oil price spikes → inflation rebounds → rate-cut expectations rise” now has a chance to be broken.

The transmission path is straightforward: ceasefire expectations → oil prices fall → inflation pressure eases → Fed rate-cut room opens up → easier liquidity is bullish for BTC. BTC rose 6.80% over 24 hours to $77,330.59, ETH gained 3.21% to $2,401.84, and XRP even surged 9.66%—the market is already voting with real money.

One-sentence translation: The expectation that the war will stop is essentially loosening conditions for global risk assets—crypto has the highest elasticity.

Market impact

- Short term: Risk-off sentiment fades. Funds that previously hid in gold and the US dollar may flow back into risk assets like BTC. BTC volume and price surged 6.80% in 24 hours, suggesting that sell pressure has largely been digested.
- Medium term: If the ceasefire is actually confirmed—oil stabilizes, inflation cools, the probability of a September Fed rate cut increases—then easier liquidity is the biggest medium-term narrative for the crypto market. Conversely, if it’s just Iran’s one-sided bluster and Israel doesn’t engage, the conflict could keep flaring; then some of the gains would likely be given back.

My take

I’m bullish on the direction, but not blindly bullish. Calling for ceasefire is only the first step; the landing still depends on follow-up negotiations. After BTC holds $77,330.59, the next test is whether it can defend the $75K prior high-density trading zone; if there’s a reversal in the Middle East (e.g., Israel’s retaliatory action), a pullback is likely. ETH follows BTC—whether it can stabilize around $2,400 is key. My view: the main thesis holds—geopolitical easing + rate-cut expectations—but the rhythm will likely see repeats; chasing highs is worse than waiting for a pullback to confirm.

【Retail investors think “after a 27% rise it’s time to run,” but the data slaps back】

Many people see ETH up 27% this week and the first reaction is, “That’s about enough,” “Time to get out.” I’m all too familiar with this—back in 2017 I got cut because of it. I ran after a small move up, and then it doubled again.

But this time I’m not hesitating because of the price—I’m hesitating because of the underlying fund flows.

In the past 48 hours, ETF inflows have exceeded $800 million. Of that, ETH funds saw a daily inflow of $220 million, the highest since October. Institutions are buying—that’s a fact, not something I’m making up. Even more important: within two days, nearly $3.8 billion worth of short positions were closed, breaking the record since 2021.

Do you know what that means?

When leveraged shorts get swept, it means the shorting force in the near term has been cleaned out. But it also means—potential long momentum has already been partially consumed ahead of time. Institutions are buying spot ETFs, while what’s getting swept is high-leverage shorts. Put together, the effect is: price is pushed up, but the real selling pressure hasn’t arrived yet.

Right now, ETH is stuck around 2400, with resistance at 2492. This level is interesting—up by another 4% puts it into a strong pressure zone. If it breaks out, longs will likely ride the move. But if it can’t hold here, a pullback to 2260 becomes possible.

Someone asked me why institutions are buying ETH at this time. One story is that ETH has retraced 51% from its high. For those old retail “veterans” from 2017, that number carries a psychological cue: “Back then, I bought the dip right around here.” But whether that logic can actually play out depends on whether the ETF product design and institutional compliance processes can truly absorb the capital.

I’m currently leaning cautious. Not because I’m bearish, but because chasing in at this level doesn’t offer a good risk-reward. Opportunities are in two places: either wait for a breakout above 2492, then look for confirmation on the pullback; or wait for 2260 to hold, followed by a second rally.

Of course, these are just my thoughts—if I get it wrong, it’s not on me.

What state are you in right now? Is your position heavy? When this run-up happened, did you get itchy or not?

【散户以为“涨了27%就该跑了”，但数据打脸了】

很多人看到ETH这周涨了27%，第一反应是“差不多了吧”“该跑了”。这种想法我太熟了，2017年我被割就是栽在这个上面——涨了一点就跑，结果跑完又翻倍。

但这次让我犹豫的不是价格，是背后的资金流向。

过去48小时，ETF流入了超过8亿美元，其中ETH基金单日流入2.2亿，是10月以来最高的。机构在买，这是事实，不是我的意淫。更关键的是，两天内将近38亿美元的空头被平仓——这个数字破了2021年以来的记录。

你懂这意味着什么吗？

杠杆空头被扫了，意味着短期做空的力量被清洗了一遍。但这也意味着——潜在的多头力量已经被提前消耗了一部分。机构买的是现货ETF，而被扫的是高杠杆空头，两者叠加的效果就是：价格被推上去，但真正的抛压还没来。

现在ETH卡在2400，阻力在2492。这个位置有意思——往上4%就是强压力区间，如果突破，多头会顺势；但如果这个位置横不住，回撤到2260的可能性就存在。

有人问我为什么机构这个时候买ETH？有一种说法是，ETH从高点回撤了51%，对于2017年那波老韭菜来说，这个数字有心理暗示——“当年我在这个位置抄底过”。但这个逻辑能不能落地，要看ETF的产品设计和机构合规流程能不能真正把资金接住。

我现在偏谨慎。不是看空，是觉得这个位置追进去，盈亏比不划算。机会在两个地方：要么等突破2492之后回调确认，要么等2260守住后的二次拉升。

当然，这只是我的判断，说错了我也不负责。

你们现在什么状态？仓位重不重？这波涨上来手痒没痒过？

When $ETH  breaks a resistance level, many traders immediately enter.

Here are 4 things to check:

🔹 1. Daily Close
Did ETH actually close above resistance, or was it only an intraday spike?

🔹 2. Volume
A breakout supported by increasing spot volume is generally more convincing than a move on weak volume.

🔹 3. Retest
The strongest setup can come when old resistance becomes new support.

🔹 4. Market Structure
Look for higher highs and higher lows on higher timeframes.

📌 Simple framework:

Breakout → Volume confirmation → Retest → Continuation

Don't buy simply because the candle is green.

title: Your Biggest Risk May Be the Story You Tell Yourself.
subTitle:
Every investment begins with a story. "This project will grow." Adoption will increase." "This technology will change the industry." "Price will eventually reflect its potential." A story can give you conviction.
But a story can also become a trap. Once we become emotionally attached to an investment, we may start interpreting every piece of information in a way that supports our belief.
Good news becomes confirmation. Bad news becomes "temporary." Warning signs become "FUD." And suddenly, we're no longer evaluating the investment. We're defending it.
🔑 Key Takeaway: A thesis should guide your investment not imprison you. Your job isn't to make your original prediction come true. Your job is to continually ask whether the evidence still supports it.
🧠 Practical Reflection; Ask yourself: If I didn't already own this asset, would today's information make me want to buy it?" That question can expose emotional attachment surprisingly quickly.
Thought for the Day. Conviction is knowing why you believe. Wisdom is knowing what could change your mind.
Systems over emotion. Conviction over noise.

一句话翻译：政府借的钱越多，钱本身越不值钱，硬资产越吃香。

对市场的影响
- 短期：传导路径很清晰——美元走弱→以美元计价的硬资产吸引力上升→资金流入BTC和黄金。这不是加密圈内资金轮动，是宏观资金在重新定价美元，量级完全不同。XRP都涨了10.72%，说明是普涨行情，风偏整体抬升。
- 中期：如果赤字问题持续发酵，“贬值交易”会反复出现，每次美债拍卖不理想、收益率飙升，都可能成为BTC的买点叙事。BTC作为“数字黄金”的定位会被宏观资金进一步强化。

我的判断
看多，但不是无脑多。这波$78,108的上涨有真实宏观逻辑支撑，不是单纯情绪。关键看美元指数能不能延续弱势——美元弱，叙事就在；美元反弹，短期就要回踩。下方关注前期突破位能否撑住回踩，上方若放量站稳$78K一线，空间才打开。风险点是美联储若转鹰、美元反弹，宏观资金撤退速度会很快。

【Institutions are quietly adding to their positions—what are you waiting for?】

Honestly, in this kind of market recently, the thing to fear most isn’t missing out—it’s not being able to make sense of it.

ETH is up 34% over the past seven days, and 6.7% in the last 24 hours. The numbers look great, but do you think retail traders are chasing it? Don’t be naive. Look at the ETF data: Ether ETFs saw a single-day inflow of $221 million, and the total for August already broke $1 billion—last time this number was reached was back in October last year.

What are institutions doing? They’re buying. Not the kind of buying that chases pumps and dumps, but the kind that buys more as prices fall.

So from a business-logic perspective, what does this mean?

Let me break it down for you:

Institutional capital has a feature—they don’t play in the short term. When ETF money comes in, it gets locked in for at least six months. What they want is certainty. What can give institutions certainty?

ETH staking rewards
ETH’s value capture as an L2 settlement layer
The upcoming Pectra upgrade

Which of these has already landed? None yet—they’re all in the pipeline. But institutions never bet on “already.” They bet on what “is about to be.”

So who will be affected?

Think about it: institutional position costs are transparent, and ETF data is published every week. Once the cost range of these “smart money” players becomes known to the market, what do you think will happen?

How far this rally can go—I can’t predict. But one thing I’m sure of: historically, every time there’s a large-scale ETF inflow, it’s followed by a not-short period of upward movement. The only difference is whether the rise is fast or slow.

So my question is: are you stepping in together with institutions, or are you going to wait for them to finish and then come in as the one picking up the tab?

怎么回事
Glassnode最新报告指出，一类被称为“高信念买家”的地址——就是那些买了不动、穿越牛熊都不卖的持仓者——从今年1月开始一直在持续加仓BTC。更有意思的是，这轮周期的累计吸筹量占总供应量的比例，已经超过了上一轮周期。而且这个囤币形态和2022年出现过的情况很像。一句话翻译：价格虽然颠簸，但最沉得住气的钱一直在悄悄接货。

对市场的影响
- 短期：这类地址的特点是不看盘、只囤不卖，意味着市场上真正可流通的筹码在变少。BTC现在$77,924.22，24h涨了4.26%，XRP更是涨了16.22%，情绪已经在修复。浮筹少了，波动会被放大，砸盘时接盘的弹性反而更强。
- 中期：2022年那个形态之后，市场走出了底部。如果历史有参考性，筹码集中度提高通常对应的是波动率下降、持币成本上移，为下一轮行情打地基。

我的判断
我倾向看多。逻辑很简单：这轮跌下来，跑的是短线和杠杆，留下的是越跌越买的长期资金，持仓结构比价格本身更健康。风险点也直说——链上数据是后视镜，高信念买家也有认输的时候，2022年那次形态之后也是先深蹲再起来的。BTC如果回踩$77,924.22一线能撑住，结构就没坏；跌破的话这套叙事就要打折扣。

[A repeat of history? This time, the roles of institutions and retail traders have been swapped]

In 2017, when I saw price moving like this, my first reaction was: “Quick, get on board—miss this village and you’ll find no other shop.” What happened afterward? You all know the rest—I was standing guard on the mountaintop, while others down below were picking up the chips.

But this time is different.

Look at the latest data: for two consecutive days, ETFs saw large inflows. On August 20 alone, an Ether fund took in $220 million. Institutions aren’t here to lift retail traders onto the platform—they’re here to grab positions. At the same time, shorts have been liquidated for two straight days, totaling nearly $4 billion wiped out. What is this? It’s a squeeze—an institutional-driven short squeeze.

In 2019, the script was basically the same, just with a different cover—back then it was futures; now it’s ETFs.

In plain language: the money flowing into ETFs isn’t for short-term speculation. It’s institutional allocation capital. What are the characteristics of allocation capital? It doesn’t enter today and exit tomorrow. Once it comes in, it locks in. So this rally isn’t driven by FOMO and market sentiment—it’s built on real money.

So why do I say it will consolidate instead of continuing to chase the breakout? Because price has already reached the resistance level. $ 2592.73 is right above our heads, within arm’s reach. In just 7 days, it’s up 33%. There’s no way that speed can be sustained indefinitely. Profits could be taken and sold off at any moment—but it can’t break down, because the ETF inflow money below is support.

Where might my call be wrong? If $ 2291.49 breaks down, it means the ETF money is starting to withdraw—then I’ll have to admit I was wrong. If it keeps rising on shrinking volume, that’s even more dangerous, because that would indicate retail traders are FOMO-buying the top.

So what’s your mindset right now? Are you willing to take the risk this time? My hand is itching, but I really didn’t go in this time. The feeling of watching from the sidelines with no position is worse than missing the trade—you know what I mean.

#ETH #加密市场 #PIPEDOG #Market sense

【历史重演？这次机构和散户的角色换了个位置】

2017年的我，看到这种涨法，第一反应是"赶紧上车，错过这村没这店"。结果呢？后来的故事你们都知道了——我在山顶站岗，别人在山下捡筹码。

但这次不一样。

你看最近的数据：ETF连续两天大额流入，8月20号当天Ether基金就进了2.2个亿美元。机构不是来给散户抬轿子的，他们是来抢筹的。与此同时，空头被连续两天清算，总共将近40亿美元灰飞烟灭。这是什么？这是机构的逼空行情。2019年的剧本换个皮又演了一遍——只不过当年是期货，现在换成了ETF。

说人话：ETF进来的钱，不是短线投机的钱，是大机构的配置盘。配置盘的特点是什么？不会今天进明天出，进了就是锁仓。所以这波涨，不是情绪驱动的FOMO，是真金白银堆出来的底。

那为什么我说震荡而不是继续追涨？因为价格已经到阻力位了。$ 2592.73就在头顶，近在咫尺。7天涨了33%，这种速度不可能一直维持。获利盘随时可能砸一波下来，但砸不下去，因为下边ETF进来的钱就是支撑。

什么情况我判断错了？如果$ 2291.49破位，说明 ETF 的钱也开始撤了，那我就得认栽。如果继续缩量上涨，那更危险，说明是散户在FOMO接盘。

你们现在什么心态？这波敢不敢？我手是真痒，但我这次真没上。空仓看戏的滋味，比踏空还难受，你们懂的。

translatedData.content:
#dusk $DUSK @Dusk_Foundation  Do you remember that cross-chain bridge fiasco earlier this year? Hackers easily siphoned away nearly 11 million $DUSK  coins, like water from a cup. When the “root cause” was finally revealed, it was baffling: the single-signature wallet had been directly breached. Afterward, the project team just lay flat and took the mockery, admitting that the trust mechanism was overly concentrated—essentially planting a bomb in the system.

With such a huge black history hanging over them, when I look at the “compliant privacy finance” path that @Dusk_Foundation  has been aggressively pitching recently, my head is full of exclamation marks. The little essay they posted on August 15 sounded quite pleasant: they claim that you can’t build liquidity just by issuing tokens—you have to tie identity verification, transaction routing, and underlying settlement together. Sounds straightforward, but once you peel open the whitepaper and pick at the wording, it’s basically a “wound-healer, forgetting the pain.”

The most ridiculous part is that the mainnet’s underlying layer secretly contains a so-called “God mode” that can forcibly move funds and tamper with the ledger. And there’s also an identity review mechanism called Citadel—want to get in and play? You must get offline institutions to stamp approval, and if the service provider doesn’t like you, they can blacklist you and kick you out anytime. “Decentralization”? This isn’t decentralization at all—it’s just that pure code was too rigid, so they recruited a batch of “network admin lords” who call all the shots, stepping on the bottom line of de-trust.

In reality, doing finance means adapting to regulation, but if one-sided enforcement power isn’t bound by a tight “collar,” how many retail investors would dare to put real money in? Under what extreme circumstances can you directly yank the plug to liquidate positions? How do you prevent offline review nodes from colluding to set up a trap? Who supervises those privileges that can just flip the table at will? After the turmoil in January, haven’t we learned enough from what happens when you hand your lifeline to a single control point—especially with $BTC’s anti-censorship core?

So for today’s Dusk, I’m blocking all the big talk being sold to people in the primary market—I’m only focused on one thing: is this highest privilege locked or not? Don’t use “embracing compliance” as a shield to demand unlimited power. Zero-knowledge proofs can indeed help hide account data, but they can’t stop someone with the super key from directly raiding your backyard. #eth $ETH

content:
#dusk $DUSK @Dusk_Foundation  还记得今年初跨链桥被掏空那档子事吗？将近 1100 万枚 $DUSK 被黑客像喝水一样轻松划走。原因揭晓时简直让人两眼一抹黑：居然是因为单点签名的钱包直接被爆破了。项目方事后倒是躺平任嘲，直言信任机制过度集中，本质上就是在系统里埋雷。

顶着这么大个黑历史，我再去看 @Dusk_Foundation 最近疯狂忽悠的“合规隐私金融”路线，脑袋里全是感叹号。他们 8 月 15 号发的小作文写得倒是挺悦耳：光靠发币搞不出流动性，非得把身份核验、交易流转跟底层结算全绑在一块儿才行。话糙理不糙，可一旦扒开白皮书去抠字眼，这就纯纯是好了伤疤忘了疼。

最离谱的是，主网底层里竟然暗藏着可以强行划走资金、篡改账本的“上帝模式”。还有那个叫 Citadel 的身份审查机制，你想进来玩？必须得找线下的机构点头盖章，而且服务商看你不爽，随时能拉黑赶人。这叫去中心化？这明明是嫌纯代码太死板，自己又招安了一批说一不二的“网管老爷”，把去信任化的底线踩在脚下。

现实里搞金融确实要迎合监管，但这种单方面的执法权要是没个紧箍咒，咱们散户谁敢真金白银往里冲？到底什么极端情况下能直接拔网线平仓？线下审核的节点要是联合做局怎么防？这种能随意掀桌子的特权究竟谁来监督？经历了 1 月那场风波，再看看 $BTC 的抗审查内核，把命脉交到一个控制点手里的下场咱们还没吃够教训吗？

所以对现在的 Dusk，一级市场吹的那些牛皮我统统屏蔽，我只盯住一件事：这个最高权限到底有没有加锁？别拿“拥抱合规”当做索要无上限权力的挡箭牌。零知识证明确实能帮你隐藏账户数据，但它根本防不住拿了超级钥匙的人直接抄你后院。#eth $ETH

In the early days of that cross-chain bridge theft disaster back in #dusk $DUSK @Dusk_Foundation , I bet you still haven’t forgotten, my friends. Nearly 11 million $DUSK  were snatched away by hackers as easily as taking something from a pocket. The vulnerability turned out to be the kind of single-signature wallet failure that truly leaves you speechless. The official side admitted the mistake pretty quickly, saying plainly that they had put all their trust into a single node—basically a powder keg waiting to blow up at any moment.

With that painful lesson, I went to look into @Dusk_Foundation  and the “compliant privacy finance” they’re hard-pressing on right now. And I can’t help but feel uneasy. They said it clearly in their August 15 post: just tokenizing assets and squeezing doesn’t generate liquidity—you need to connect identity verification, from transactions all the way to settlement. The logic checks out, but when I dug through the technical documentation’s corners and crevices, I found this is clearly just walking an old road.

Most outrageous of all: the underlying base layer of the main chain actually hides a kind of “God mode” that can forcefully transfer funds and modify registries. And the “Citadel” identity system they’ve been praising is even more absurd—want to enter the game? You have to get in by looking at the mood of offline institutions and obtaining a sort of “pass document,” and the service provider can pull the plug and kick you out in seconds. How is this embracing decentralization? It’s more like they dislike rigid pure code, so they’ve gone and raised a whole bunch of “super administrators” who hold the power of life and death.

Traditional finance does need regulation, but once the “hand of God” is left unchecked, we’d all be right to be afraid: in what extreme scenario could assets be liquidated or forcibly settled? If offline authentication nodes collude to do evil, who’s going to manage that? This kind of system backdoor that rules everything doesn’t even have basic constraint mechanisms. Thinking back to the traps $BTC has walked through over the years, and then looking at the bloodbath in January, you all know how painful the backlash is when someone has absolute control.

So right now, I have zero interest in Dusk and the blueprint that private funds are drawing. My only demand is this: can this absolute power really be locked up in an iron cage for good? Hiding behind the banner of “compliance” to demand limitless permissions—this kind of façade doesn’t hold. Even if zero-knowledge proofs are great at protecting your transaction privacy, they can’t stop someone with the highest privileges from stabbing you in the back behind the scenes. #eth $ETH

📊 RESUMO DA SEMANA: GEOPOLÍTICA, ECONOMIA E O RALI QUE PEGOU O MERCADO CRIPTO DE SURPRESA
Semana de virada para quem estava desanimado com o mercado. Depois de meses de correção, o BTC voltou a mostrar força — e não sozinho.
🔥 O que aconteceu com o Bitcoin
O BTC começou a semana negociando perto de US$ 63.000, num clima de pessimismo generalizado (Fear & Greed Index em 40, sentimento de varejo defensivo). A virada veio na quarta-feira, com a SEC anunciando uma nova proposta de regulação pra ofertas de cripto, puxando o preço de volta pra casa dos US$ 79.000.
Mas o verdadeiro estopim foi o Tesouro americano: o secretário Scott Bessent anunciou que vai dobrar o volume de recompra de títulos de longo prazo — uma forma de injetar liquidez no sistema sem passar diretamente pelo Fed. Somado a isso, Trump pressionou publicamente o Congresso a votar o CLARITY Act, projeto de lei que define de vez se cripto é valor mobiliário ou mercadoria nos EUA, hoje travado no Senado.
O resultado: o BTC saltou quase 20% em cinco dias, rompendo os US$ 75.000 na sexta-feira — o melhor desempenho semanal desde março de 2024. Quase US$ 2 bilhões em posições vendidas foram liquidadas no processo, o que acelerou ainda mais a subida (short squeeze).

📈 O efeito cascata nas altcoins
Quando o BTC dispara desse jeito, o mercado inteiro segue atrás — e foi exatamente isso que vimos. ETH subiu mais de 17% só na quinta-feira, voltando a superar US$ 2.400. XRP disparou quase 20% em 24h. SOL e praticamente todo o mercado andaram junto, com ETFs de Bitcoin registrando as maiores entradas de capital em meses (mais de US$ 500 milhões só na quinta).
O motivo por trás desse "efeito cascata": quando o ativo dominante do mercado (BTC) sobe com força e volume real, capital que estava na defensiva volta a girar pra dentro do setor como um todo — inclusive pra ativos de maior risco.

🌐 O pano de fundo geopolítico e econômico
Vale lembrar que essa recuperação não acontece no vácuo. O mercado ainda carrega duas tensões não resolvidas: um choque inflacionário ligado a tarifas comerciais e uma guerra ainda ativa entre EUA e Irã, afetando uma das principais rotas de energia do mundo. Analistas apontam que essas tensões seguem no radar, mesmo com o rali recente.

📅 O que esperar pra semana que vem
O grande evento no radar é o Jackson Hole Symposium, de 27 a 29 de agosto — o retiro anual dos principais banqueiros centrais do mundo. Será a primeira grande fala pública do novo presidente do Fed, Kevin Warsh, desde que assumiu em maio. Ele já sinalizou que não vai seguir o padrão de sinalizar decisões com antecedência, o que aumenta a imprevisibilidade do discurso.
O mercado hoje precifica cerca de 1 em cada 3 chances de alta de juros em setembro — número que pode mudar rápido dependendo do tom de Warsh. Um discurso mais dovish tende a sustentar o rali; um tom mais duro pode travar o movimento antes da decisão de setembro.
Um final de semana tranquilo pra todos vocês — e que a próxima semana traga clareza pro mercado, seja qual for a direção. 🚀

#termmax @termmax  Everyone is eagerly awaiting the TGE on August 25, but what I’m really thinking about is something else: once we make it to August 26, after the airdrop farmers take the empty-airdrop tokens and cash out by smashing the charts, how much of the @termmax  pool can still be left with real returning customers?

On paper, the numbers look really impressive: TVL breaking $90 million, 1.5 million wallet addresses, and even claiming that there are 90,000 users “actively going crazy” every day. But once we break it down and take a closer look, the daily active rate is barely around 6%. That huge gap is really striking.

In the end, TermMax’s round of “paying to attract users with crypto incentives” is simply a bit too overpowered. To chase performance, the official started by depositing money into the RLUSD pool, providing 5 million TMX to kick things off. Then it really went on a rampage—working together with Venus to create an exaggerated 120x experience expansion. Next, it even force-fed 200,000 XP in two installments into Binance wallets. Even right at the moment right before the token launch, they didn’t forget to take out another 2 million TMX to splurge again. Retail activity was basically “fed” artificially through all kinds of link-clicking, authorization, and reward tasks involving staking.

Then comes the toughest test: what if tomorrow you completely pull the plug on the “money-spraying” switch—can the whole operation still run?

A few days ago, the RLUSD treasury managed to rake in $20 million within 48 hours, which only proves that “as long as the money is enough, miracles can happen.” But what I truly care about is this: after the event ends, 7 days or 30 days later, how much real money is still sitting there. Only the people who stay in the protocol even without any XP or MP incentive are the ones that truly test whether this “fixed interest rate” thing is real demand or just a fake one.

If this wave of hype cools down and the platform’s core lending data doesn’t really collapse, then it shows TermMax’s methods are genuinely strong—strong enough to convert a bunch of speculators into loyal OGs. But if the moment you stop the air drop, everyone instantly scatters, and the only way to keep it alive is to keep throwing money in waves—then those 1.5 million addresses are nothing more than short-lived “prosperity” bought with wasted money, with basically nothing to do with user stickiness.

The real challenge TermMax will face next is its underlying product logic: what exactly does it have to keep those people who are always ready to run off with their bags? #eth $ETH

#termmax @termmax  大家都在翘首以盼 8 月 25 日的 TGE 大戏，但我心里更惦记另一件事：熬到了 8 月 26 日，羊毛党们拿着空投砸盘套现之后，@termmax 这个盘子究竟还能剩下多少真实的回头客？

账面上的数据现在看着确实挺唬人：突破 9000 万美元的 TVL，150 万个钱包地址，每天号称还有 9 万个号在疯狂交互。但咱们拆开揉碎了看，日活跃比例也就勉强够到 6%。这个巨大的数字差其实非常刺眼。

说到底，TermMax 这一波“氪金拉新”搞得实在是有点用力过猛了。为了冲业绩，官方从往 RLUSD 池子里存钱就给 500 万 TMX 开始，一路狂飙，联合 Venus 搞出了夸张的 120 倍经验膨胀，紧接着又在币安钱包分两期硬塞了 20 万 XP。就连马上要发币的节骨眼上，都没忘记再拿 200 万 TMX 出来狂撒一波。散户们的活跃度，完全就是靠着各种点链接、给授权、做质押的奖励任务给硬生生喂出来的。

那么最头疼的考验来了：假如明天就把“撒钱”的开关给彻底拔了，这摊子业务还能转得动吗？

前几天 RLUSD 金库能在 48 小时内狂揽 2000 万美元，这只能说明“只要钱给够，什么奇迹都有”。但我真正在乎的，比如活动结束 7 天或者 30 天之后，账上到底还能趴着多少真金白银。那些在没有任何 XP 和 MP 奖励诱惑下，还能坚持留在协议里的人，才是检验“固定利率”这玩意儿到底是不是伪需求的真金。

TermMax 接下来要面对的真正难关，是它的产品底层逻辑，究竟拿什么来留住那些随时准备提桶跑路的人。#eth $ETH

【ETH this week: some people finally waited, and some may have to miss again】

A week ago, ETH was still hovering around $ 1900-plus. A month ago it was even worse—nearly $ 1700. So where is it today? $ 2517. In the past 24 hours it surged 8.3%, and over 7 days it’s up 34%.

Honestly, I’ve seen this kind of move before. Every time institutions bring in real, hard money, the market behaves like this—not a slow grind up, but a blunt blow to anyone still hesitating.

In the past couple of days, the combined inflows into BTC and ETH ETFs are close to $2 billion. Last week’s Ether ETF inflows were the largest since October. And the BTC ETF even pushed the total from August to above $2 billion. Another data point makes the picture even clearer—short positions liquidated over these two days are close to $3.8 billion, and yesterday alone directly set a record since 2021.

What does “institutions entering” look like? This is it.

I mentioned earlier that technical analysis is only a support tool—the real change in tempo comes from capital and sentiment. Now, when both signals appear at the same time, what does that mean?

What does this mean in practical terms? Large-scale ETF inflows mean a lot of capital from traditional markets is allocating to ETH. This money isn’t here to trade short-term. Their holding periods are at least measured in quarters. For miners, staking service providers, and DeFi protocols, it’s directly bullish—once the capital comes in, they need an exit, and the protocol layer will absorb this liquidity.

From a business-logic standpoint, the approval of the ETF itself is also a signal: U.S. regulators are giving the green light to traditional capital. The long-term impact of this is far more than just this week’s price move.

But I should also remind myself: did I misjudge anything this week? Of course I did. I didn’t expect the rally to come so fast, and I didn’t expect the sentiment switch to be so decisive. There are plenty of people who got left behind, including myself—I also didn’t think the strength would be this big.

Key focus next week? $ 2592 is the key resistance level. Once it breaks through, it should move quickly. Support is at $ 2278; if that breaks, the short-term outlook will need to be reassessed.

Have you gotten on board for this move? Or are you still waiting for a “more certain opportunity”?

#ETH #加密分析 #BTC #Market Insights

说真的，这种走法我见过。每次机构真金白银进来的时候，市场就是这样——不是慢慢涨，是给还在犹豫的人一记闷棍。

这两天BTC和ETH的ETF合计流入了差不多20亿美元。Ether ETF上周的资金流入是10月以来最大的，BTC ETF更是把8月的总量拱到了20亿美元以上。另一个数据更说明问题——这两天被清算的空头头寸将近38亿美元，昨天直接刷了2021年以来的纪录。

什么叫机构在进场？这就是了。

我之前说过，技术分析只是辅助，真正改变节奏的是资金和情绪。现在这两个信号同时出现，说明什么？

这事落到实处意味着什么？ETF大规模流入意味着有大量传统市场的资金在配置ETH。这些钱不是来炒短线的，它们的持有周期至少以季度计。对矿工、质押服务商、DeFi协议都是直接利好——资金进来就要找出口，协议层面会承接这波流动性。

从商业逻辑看，ETF获批本身就是个信号：美国监管层在给传统资金开绿灯，这件事的长期影响远不止这周的涨幅。

下周重点？$ 2592这个阻力位是关键，突破了上去就快了。支撑看$ 2278，破了的话短期得重新评估。

这波你上车了吗？还是说又在等"更确定的机会"？

title: Criptomonedas en Centroamérica
subTitle:
América Latina, y en particular Centroamérica, muestra una adopción heterogénea de criptomonedas, variando desde esquemas estatales de reserva fiscal hasta su uso intensivo para el comercio informal, el ahorro y la recepción de remesas.
​Panorama General por País
​El Salvador:  
​Marco Regulatorio y Estado: Mantiene a Bitcoin como moneda de curso legal, aunque los ajustes regulatorios han flexibilizado la aceptación comercial haciéndola voluntaria para comercios.  
​Reservas Estatales: El gobierno sigue acumulando reservas en BTC de manera constante, superando los 7,600 BTC en el erario público.
​Uso Real: A pesar de la infraestructura estatal (billetera Chivo, Bonos Volcán), la adopción ciudadana diaria para pagos transaccionales es moderada. Las remesas directas en cripto han experimentado contracciones frente a los métodos de envío tradicionales.
​Honduras:
​Zonas Especiales (ZEDE): Próspera (Roatán) adoptó Bitcoin como unidad de cuenta para transacciones, impuestos y operaciones comerciales dentro de su jurisdicción local.
​Banca Tradicional y Regulador: El Banco Central de Honduras (BCH) mantiene una postura cautelosa sobre las criptomonedas no reguladas a nivel nacional, advirtiendo sobre los riesgos, mientras monitorea avances en Monedas Digitales de Banco Central (CBDC) y tecnologías DLT.
​Costa Rica:
​Ecosistema Financiero y Fintech: Lidera la región centroamericana en el desarrollo de startups fintech e integración de pagos cripto en el sector turístico y de servicios para nómadas digitales.
​Regulación: Operar con criptomonedas es legal bajo el principio de libertad contractual del Código Civil. Los bancos comerciales ofrecen cada vez más apertura a cuentas vinculadas con empresas de activos digitales supervisadas por la SUGEF.  
​Guatemala:
​Remesas y Stablecoins: Guatemala registra uno de los mayores volúmenes de remesas en la región. Aunque la mayoría transita por vías bancarias tradicionales, hay un uso creciente de stablecoins (USDT/USDC) en canales P2P (peer-to-peer) para reducir comisiones bancarias.
​Proyecto Bitcoin Lake: Proyectos comunitarios en el Lago de Atitlán siguen el modelo de economía circular basado en Bitcoin, enfocado en inclusión financiera rural y educación digital.
​Panamá:  
​Centro Financiero e Impuestos: La Ciudad de Panamá ha integrado pilotos para permitir el pago de ciertos impuestos municipales y servicios en activos digitales.
​Entorno Operativo: Funciona como un centro de operaciones clave para firmas internacionales y exchanges debido a la flexibilidad de sus licencias comerciales, a la espera de la consolidación de un marco normativo nacional unificado.
​Nicaragua:
​Contexto: Adopción limitada impulsada principalmente por el ahorro individual informal frente a restricciones de acceso al sistema bancario internacional y volatilidad cambiaria.
​Factores Comunes de Impulso en la Región
​Reducción del Costo de Remesas: Centroamérica es altamente dependiente de las remesas de EE. UU. Las red de pagos sobre la red Lightning de Bitcoin y el uso de stablecoins continúan posicionándose como alternativas frente a los costos de las giros tradicionales.  
​Inclusión Financiera: Más del 50% de la población adulta centroamericana carece de acceso a servicios bancarios formales, convirtiendo a las billeteras digitales en una alternativa directa de bancarización.#BTC #GoldReboundsNearly5% #ETH #GRAM $BTC {spot}(BTCUSDT)

Using ETH as collateral to borrow USDC can offer another path. The fixed-rate structure is especially interesting because borrowers can know their borrowing cost in advance for a specific period, rather than constantly dealing with a floating rate affected by market supply and demand.

But this strategy is not free money. ETH can fall, and a significant decline in collateral value can create liquidation risk. Responsible borrowing means maintaining a safety buffer instead of borrowing the maximum possible amount.

What I find most interesting about TermMax is the focus on capital flexibility. Your long-term assets don’t necessarily have to be sold just because you need short-term liquidity.

再看BEAT，0.1752，涨了48.6%。这个币有意思，量能只有0.7倍均量，属于缩量上涨。这就很微妙了——缩量拉升要警惕，说明追高的人不多，全靠存量资金在拉。价格位于区间69%处，不像TRUMP那么极端。近8根阻力0.1813，支撑0.1542。我的判断是：这个位置追多风险偏大，不如等回踩。如果回踩到0.155-0.16区间企稳，可以尝试偏多方向，止损0.145，第一目标0.18，RR约1:2。但如果放量跌破0.1542，那就说明这波结束了，别硬扛。

现在恐惧贪婪指数65，处于贪婪区间，BTC 24h涨了4.8%，ETH涨了7%，整个市场情绪偏暖。但我得说句大实话——这种时候反而要冷静。涨幅榜前十里一堆政治币、迷因币，跌幅榜上ONG直接-36%，AVAAI -27%，这种分化说明资金在快速轮动，今天涨的明天可能就是跌的。情绪到65说明大家已经开始贪婪了，但还没到极度贪婪，所以还有空间，但也要开始注意仓位管理了。

上周我就在关注ZEC这个位置，当时还觉得700以上有点贵，现在回头看真是打脸（手动狗头）。不过这也说明一个道理：在这个市场里，趋势来了就要顺势，别总想着抄底逃顶，赚自己看得懂的钱就够了。

最后说下整体策略：现在这个位置，我倾向于等回调再进场，而不是追高。市场给了机会就抓住，没给就等着，机会天天有。你们怎么看TRUMP这波？觉得是真突破还是假突破？评论区聊聊。

If nothing major and crazy happens by the weekend, then $BTC  this week basically can be recorded as the most notable market performance from the past three years.

It rallied all the way from the start of the week to nearly $80,000, with the highest intraday gain in the week reaching close to 23%. You know, not long ago the market was still debating whether $60,000 would hold—and now the vibe is: when will $80,000 break?

For this rally, I think the most worth watching thing isn’t “how much it rose,” but how fast the market sentiment has changed.

A few weeks ago, everyone was still afraid of more downside, with capital being cautious and tight-lipped; even altcoins—nobody dared touch them. But this week, U.S. policy expectations turned warmer, liquidity expectations heated up, ETF inflows returned, and on top of that, a large number of shorts were forced to cover—those factors together lit the fuse. BTC went from “nobody dares to chase” to “afraid we’ll miss the train.”

This is the most familiar script in crypto land:

When it’s above $60k, people think it’s too expensive and fear the drop;
When it’s above $70k, people start researching;
When it finally pushes toward $80k, people start asking whether they can still get on board.

More interestingly, this time it’s not just BTC rising. $ETH 、$XRP 、#SOL  and plenty of other altcoins have also started recovering noticeably, and risk appetite among investors is being lifted again.

But I actually think the most dangerous thing right now isn’t going bearish—it’s this: after consecutive big gains, people get carried away and start thinking the bull market is completely back.

#BTC  this week was indeed ferocious, but there’s still a considerable distance from the all-time highs. What’s truly worth watching is whether $80,000 can hold, whether ETF capital can keep flowing in consistently, and whether after BTC rallies, the funds will genuinely spread out to #ETH  and #山寨 .

If all three signals show up at the same time, then this week might not just be a one-off “violent rebound.”

It could be where the next leg of the market really starts to accelerate.

#比特币创2023年3月来最佳周表现 

如果周末不出大幺蛾子，$BTC  这周基本可以载入最近三年的行情记录了。

从周初一路拉到接近 8 万美元，周内最高涨幅接近 23%。要知道，前段时间市场还在讨论 6 万美元到底守不守得住，现在画风直接变成：8 万美元什么时候破？

这轮上涨，我觉得最值得看的不是“涨了多少”，而是市场情绪变得太快了。

前几周大家还在怕继续跌，资金缩手缩脚，山寨更是没人敢碰；结果这一周，美国政策预期转暖、流动性预期升温、ETF 资金重新回流，再叠加大量空头被迫回补，几个因素一起点火，BTC 直接从“没人敢追”变成了“生怕上不了车”。

这就是币圈最熟悉的剧本：

6 万多的时候嫌贵、怕跌；
7 万多的时候开始研究；

The U.S. Treasury is aggressively repurchasing U.S. Treasuries, and the market treats it as a form of de facto QE—liquidity expectations pushing BTC up by 5.57%.

Recently, the U.S. Treasury has been conducting large-scale buybacks of U.S. Treasuries. The official line says this is not quantitative easing (QE), but merely normal liquidity management. Traders don’t buy it, though—repo is essentially putting cash back into the market. The effect is the same playbook as the Fed printing money to buy bonds back in the day, so people call it “not-QE.”

Once banks receive the cash, they have to find where to put it. Risk assets are usually the first to benefit. Market impact
- Short term: The transmission path is straightforward—Treasury repo → more cash in the banking system → higher demand for risk-asset allocation → BTC directly absorbs the liquidity tailwind. Broad-based gains across the entire market suggest a liquidity-driven beta rally, not a narrative centered on a single coin.
- Medium term: If “not-QE” becomes the norm, it’s effectively the Treasury loosening liquidity while the Fed appears tight in its messaging. That “small gap” can keep supplying the crypto market. Cautiously more bullish than bearish. The risk is currently at the “potential exposure” level, with no actual loss data. The market has voted with its feet: SOL $96.87 is up 8.49%, outperforming BTC. Rust toolchain compromised, Solana ecosystem nearly exposed to remote code execution: why didn't the coin price drop?

The Rust supply chain was attacked, and Solana development components may have been injected with malicious code—but the market basically ignored it today.

Several crates (development dependency packages) in the Rust ecosystem were poisoned. Any project that pulled those packages during the build process could, in theory, execute the attacker’s arbitrary code at compile time. Since the entire Solana ecosystem runs on Rust, once this supply chain is widely exploited, the impact wouldn’t be limited to a single project—it would affect all developer wallets and key security of everyone using the tainted dependencies. At this stage, the attack seems more targeted at development environments, and no large-scale capital losses have been reported yet.

One-sentence translation: This time they didn’t steal any money, but the development foundation of the whole chain isn’t as stable as people might think.

Market impact
- Short term: Basically none. SOL is at $96.87, up 8.49% in 24h, BTC $78,590.15 up 5.34%, and the whole market is rallying—safety-related news is drowned out directly by bull-market sentiment. ETH $2,523.3 is up 7.38%, and XRP jumped as much as 21.36%. From an “fear index” perspective, there’s no sign of any reaction.
- Medium term: This is the real focus. Regulators and institutional investors will become more sensitive to “code supply chain risk.” The Solana Foundation will likely increase investment in audits and dependency locking. After similar incidents happen again and again, each one effectively becomes an implicit advertisement for security-focused projects on-chain.

My view
In the short term, I’m slightly bullish/holding back to observe. Technical negatives will likely be absorbed in a broad market rally. After BTC breaks above $78,500 and ETH goes beyond $2,500, momentum should still be there. But this SOL issue is a slow variable: it doesn’t change today’s price—it changes a line of text on institutional due diligence checklists. If subsequent real-world exploitation cases are revealed, SOL’s relative strength versus BTC will reflect that first. The risk is that coins that are already up more than 8% may see short-term pullback momentum; a security incident is just background noise, not the main logic.

#dusk $DUSK @Dusk_Foundation Recently I’ve been obsessively digging into Dusk’s development manual, and the more I write code, the more awkward it feels. I have to admit that the project’s underlying framework is indeed built with great care. With WebAssembly, the DuskVM lets Rust contracts run directly, eliminating the hassle of complex local environment setup—so you can jump right in from the web. Also, the Contract Drivers mechanism in the W3sper SDK is quite brilliant: it basically inserts a buffer layer between the wallet and the chain, saving programmers a huge amount of time that would otherwise go into writing repetitive code. When I first read the whitepaper, this kind of taste really got me excited.

But once I actually start running real privacy-related business, the symptoms of poor fit with the environment all show up. The most surreal part of this chain is that it forces Moonlight (a publicly visible account) and Phoenix (a hidden address) to be mixed together. When you transfer visible assets into the dark pool, the system deducts from the public balance and then generates an encrypted credential (note); the reverse withdrawal flips the process. The logic works, but the moment you go deeper into the implementation, you realize its state handling, underlying instructions, and even the fee calculation rules are all essentially catering to transparent transactions. I originally copied the Gas fee estimation code for regular public transfers and tried to run it for the shielding logic—result: constant errors, the transaction gets stuck immediately, and it can’t even get through the door.

Worse than the errors is the incomplete reference material. The official keeps marketing it with the slogan “Just open a browser and you’re good to go,” but the moment you run into more edge-case scenarios, the documentation has zero examples to be found. The call logic for several core functions is not explained clearly at all. In the end, I could only harden up and dig through the official source repository to piece together clues. For a project racing against deadlines, this kind of blind debugging—feels like it’s just burning energy and time, and the trial-and-error cost is way too high.

To sum up: with a WASM environment plus a dual-track design for both public and private, the technical foundation is solid. Unfortunately, at this stage, the supporting tools and infrastructure just can’t keep up with this hardcore innovation. Want a brainless, smooth onboarding experience? It’s still far from what the official hype promised. #eth $ETH

#dusk $DUSK @Dusk_Foundation 最近死磕 Dusk 的开发手册，越敲代码越觉得别扭。不得不承认，这项目的底层骨架搭得确实讲究。DuskVM 借助 WebAssembly 让 Rust 合约直接跑起来，省去了繁杂的本地环境配置，网页端就能直接开干。另外，W3sper SDK 里的 Contract Drivers 机制也很精妙，硬是在钱包和链之间加了个缓冲垫，替程序员省下了大把写重复代码的精力。刚开始看白皮书时，这品味确实挺让人上头。

不过，等真刀真枪去跑隐私业务时，水土不服的症状全冒出来了。这条链最魔幻的地方，是硬把 Moonlight（明牌公开账户）和 Phoenix（暗牌隐匿地址）揉在了一起。把明面资产转进暗池，系统要扣除公开余额，再生成个加密凭证（note）；反向提款则倒过来。逻辑跑得通，但稍微往深了写就会发现：它的状态处理、底层指令甚至手续费计算规则，骨子里全是在迎合透明交易。我当时照搬公开转账的 Gas 费估算代码去跑屏蔽逻辑，结果就是疯狂报错，交易直接卡死，连门都进不去。

比报错更折磨人的，是残缺的参考资料。官方天天拿“打开浏览器就能搞定”做宣传噱头，结果一碰到偏门的边界情况，说明书里连个示例都找不着。几个核心功能的调用逻辑根本没写明白，最后只能硬着头皮去扒官方源码库找线索。对于赶进度的项目来说，这种盲人摸象式的调试，完全是在烧精力和时间，试错成本太离谱。

总结一下，WASM 环境加上明暗双轨制，这技术底子是过硬的。但遗憾的是，现阶段的配套工具和基建，根本兜不住这么硬核的创新。想无脑顺滑地上手？离官方吹嘘的预期还差得远。#eth $ETH

#dusk $DUSK @Dusk_Foundation  Today, I took some time to go through the developer guide for the @Dusk_Foundation , and it gives this strange sense of mismatch—“the ideal is full and splendid, but reality is bone-dry.”

Objectively speaking, its highlights really are engaging. DuskVM lets you run Rust directly with WebAssembly, completely removing the hassle of setting up local environments—its core promise is that you can get started with a pure web interface. In addition, the Contract Drivers in the W3sper component package act as “translators” between the wallet and the chain, cutting down a huge amount of tedious work involved in reinventing the wheel. From first glance, this kind of LEGO-style assembly approach really does feel quite advanced.

But when I tried to build an interaction flow with privacy attributes, I ran into obstacles everywhere. The most aggressive part of this project is that it forcibly crams two completely different data structures—Moonlight (addresses used in plain accounting) and Phoenix (addresses used in shadow accounting)—into a single block network. When funds move from public to private, the system first deducts available balance, then generates an encrypted credential (note). For the reverse operation, it destroys the credential first and then posts the accounting. On paper, the transfer logic looks fine, but in actual coding you quickly realize that its state tracking, the underlying instruction set, and even the Gas fee calculation rules are almost entirely tailored for the “public transparency” mechanism. When I tried to reuse the Gas estimation module from the public accounting flow to run a hidden transfer, the result was a barrage of exceptions—the instructions were outright rejected by the network.

More discouraging than the code errors is the official technical manual. They always tout “zero entry barrier, build it right from the web,” but the moment you touch edge cases outside the usual flow, the manual immediately becomes a paperweight. Several core API calls are nowhere to be found in the documentation, forcing me to dig through the underlying Rust source code along the network cable for answers. For a business team trying to hit deadlines, this kind of troubleshooting by “guesswork” is simply unbearable in terms of time.

In the end, with WASM plus a setup involving two lines—public and private accounting—this is a pretty hardcore exploration in its current space. But the heavy burden brought by such an avant-garde mechanism is, at least for now, something the supporting documentation and component libraries can’t really carry. If you want to achieve the smooth “easy to get started” experience that the official marketing promises, the team still has a long way to go in developer infrastructure. #eth $ETH

content:
#dusk $DUSK @Dusk_Foundation  今天抽空把 @Dusk_Foundation 的开发者指南翻了一遍，这套底层框架给人一种“理想很丰满，现实很骨感”的错位感。

客观来说，它的亮点的确抓人。DuskVM 允许直接用 WebAssembly 跑 Rust，彻底免去了折腾本地环境的烦恼，主打一个纯网页端就能开工。另外，W3sper 组件包里的 Contract Drivers 充当了钱包与链之间的“翻译官”，大幅砍掉了重复造轮子的繁琐工作。初看这套积木搭建的方式，确实让人觉得挺高级。

但是，当我准备动手撸一个带隐私属性的交互流程时，处处绊脚。这项目最激进的地方，是把 Moonlight（走明账的地址）和 Phoenix（走暗账的地址）两套截然不同的数据结构，硬是揉进了一个区块网里。资金从明转暗，系统要先划扣可用余额，再生成一个加密凭证（note）；反向操作则先销毁凭证再记账。这套流转逻辑在草稿纸上没毛病，但在实际编码时你会惊觉：它的状态追踪、底层指令集甚至 Gas 费核算规则，几乎全是为了“公开透明”那套机制量身定制的。我尝试直接复用明账的 Gas 估算模块去跑隐匿转账，下场就是疯狂抛出异常，指令直接被网络拒收。

比代码报错更劝退的，是官方的技术手册。他们总把“零门槛、网页即撸”挂在嘴边，可一旦你触碰到常规流程之外的边界情况，手册立马成了摆设。好几个核心的 API 调用在说明书里毫无踪影，逼得我只能顺着网线去扒底层的 Rust 源码找答案。对于一个要赶工期的业务来说，这种靠“猜”来摸索的排错方式，耽误的时间实在难以承受。

说到底，WASM 加上明暗两条线的设定，在目前的赛道里算是很硬核的探索。但这种前卫机制带来的沉重负担，眼下的配套说明和组件库根本扛不住。想要达到官方标榜的那种丝滑上手体验，团队在开发者基建上还有很长的路要走。#eth $ETH

CLARITY Act to be voted on in September, but a senator says the White House hasn’t provided even all its comments

The key U.S. crypto regulatory bill is being rushed to a vote, and two-party lawmakers warn that it could actually set things back—bearish for BTC sentiment.

The CLARITY Act is the most high-profile crypto market-structure bill in this round of Congress. It was originally slated for a vote in September. But Democratic Senator Gallego has directly said that, to this day, the White House has not provided line-by-line feedback on the ethical provisions agreed between the two parties. Rushing it like this could derail the entire legislative process. In plain terms, the bill text hasn’t been fully negotiated yet—forcing a vote will only increase the risk of failure. If the vote fails or is delayed, the “regulatory rollout” narrative the market has been eagerly waiting for will have to wait another quarter.

One-sentence translation: Regulatory positives haven’t been cancelled—they may just be兑现 later than expected.

Impact on the market
- Short term: A cooling in regulatory expectations is bearish. BTC is now $78,404.66, up 4.85% in 24h; ETH $2,508.62 is up 6.36%. This rebound is driven by liquidity, not policy. As news of the bill delay gains traction, some of the rally gains may be given back. Support is seen around $76,000 for BTC; if it breaks, the structure of this rebound could turn bad.
- Medium term: CLARITY will most likely still pass—just a question of timing. But if the “September rollout” timeline anchor is broken, the valuation logic for Q4 will need to be repriced.

My take
I’m cautious in the short term. In this broad-based rally, XRP has surged 17.84%, which is clearly abnormal—sentiment is already overheated. A regulatory-bearish development conveniently provides a reason for a pullback. As long as BTC holds the $76,000–$77,000 range and the structure hasn’t broken, falling prices would be digesting the policy vacuum. If it breaks below $76,000, then you have to admit defeat. Policy matters can’t be rushed.

SOL rises to around $95.06, with more than $33 million in short positions being liquidated; leveraged shorts become the fuel.
